ai_summary: BCPL Railway Infrastructure Limited reported exceptional consolidated Q1 FY26-27 results, with Profit Before Tax soaring by nearly 1000% and Revenue up over 12%, primarily driven by the new Rice Bran Oil business which contributed over 50% of consolidated EBIDTA. This new segment's robust performance significantly boosted overall profitability, completely offsetting a 4.86% year-on-year revenue decline in the standalone railway business, although the latter did improve its EBIDTA margins. The rapid growth from diversification is a key takeaway, yet the underlying revenue dip in the core segment warrants attention.
